numbers.title: The company in numbers.
numbers.1.label: Founded
numbers.1.text: Our company has more than three years of experience. We are growing fast. From the very beginning we have focused on quality, punctuality and full commitment to every project.
numbers.2.label: Phone contact
numbers.2.text: We are available to our customers around the clock, seven days a week. We know how important fast response and constant communication are, so we provide uninterrupted technical and advisory support at any time of day.
numbers.3.label: Towns visited
numbers.3.text: We have carried out pickups in 32 towns across Poland. We approach every order individually, offering full service – regardless of location.
numbers.4.label: Transformers collected
numbers.4.text: Our experience covers both small units and heavy transformers weighing dozens of tons. We work in line with applicable standards and with attention to every detail.
footer.tagline: Buying and eco-friendly processing of transformers. Best prices, fastest turnaround.
footer.cta.title: Got a transformer to collect?
footer.cta.text: Call or write – we'll collect it anywhere in Poland and pay on the spot.
